title: Represented Tensor Products of Binary Matroids: the outerplanar cographic construction (Proposition 3.2)
author: Houshan Fu, Yujiao Ma, Suijie Wang
work: Represented Tensor Products of Binary Matroids
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the paper's cographic construction for two-connected outerplanar factors, printed as Proposition 3.2 (source0.tex lines 1123-1133) and delivered with the paper's own complete 171-line proof (lines 1134-1304). The statement exhibits, for every field, every cycle C_m and every two-connected outerplanar simple graph G, an explicit graph X_{m,G} whose cycle matroid is dual to the represented tensor product, with the complete bipartite case as a specialisation. The proof is the paper's own constructive argument: it builds X_{m,G} from the outerplanar embedding, verifies the rank and circuit structure of the constructed matroid against the tensor product, tracks the representation matrices over the field through the construction, and checks the specialisation to two cycles. This is a research-level matroid-construction argument rather than a qualifying-examination exercise, so the unit is H2. Delivered with the paper's own proof, in the paper's own notation, as the single primary proof body; the unit is H2.
